log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Whimsicott

decisions.rationale: Tyranitar+Excadrill lead: Sand Stream overwrites Drizzle (blanking rain-boosted Wave Crash/Weather Ball), and Sand Rush Excadrill at ~216 Speed outruns even Mega Delphox, OHKOing Whimsicott with Iron Head and Metagross with High Horsepower. Passho Berry lets Tyranitar survive Adaptability Wave Crash. Gholdengo backs it as the Prankster lock (Good as Gold blanks Taunt/Encore, resists Moonblast, Occa vs Heat Wave); Sinistcha redirects past Queenly Majesty, resists Water, is Fighting-immune vs Tsar
decisions.notebook:
Opp (Prankster's Paradise): Whimsicott @FocusSash Prankster (Tailwind/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast, Timid 149-184); Basculegion @ChoiceScarf Adaptability (WaveCrash/LastRespects/FlipTurn/AquaJet, 98-130); Delphox @Delphoxite Blaze (HeatWave/Psychic/ShadowBall/Protect; Mega = Levitate, spe 169-204); Politoed @Sitrus Drizzle (WeatherBall/IcyWind/HelpingHand/Protect); Tsareena @WideLens QueenlyMajesty (PowerWhip/LowKick/KnockOff/Protect) - blocks priority; Metagross @LifeOrb ClearBody (MeteorMash/StompingTantrum/BulletPunch/Protect).

Key math: Excadrill Iron Head OHKOs Whimsicott through Sash-less range (106-202%). Basculegion Wave Crash into Tyranitar 78-114% before Adaptability -> effectively OHKO; Passho Berry halves it, so Tyranitar survives one. Fighting is 0x on Sinistcha (Low Kick dead). Water is 2x on Rotom-Heat - keep Rotom out vs Basculegion/Politoed.

Play plan: keep sand up; re-lead Tyranitar to deny Drizzle. Sand chips Whimsicott/Basculegion/Delphox/Politoed/Tsareena. Gholdengo answers Prankster status and Whimsicott; Sinistcha Rage Powder shields Excadrill (Queenly Majesty doesn't stop redirection). Watch Encore on Protect, Taunt on Tyranitar, and Icy Wind slowing Excadrill. Rotom-Heat/Mega Floette held as game-2/3 swaps if they lean Tsareena/Metagross-heavy.

decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott+Basculegion to establish Tailwind and pressure immediately. Preserve Politoed in back to overwrite sand before Water attacks. Mega Delphox completes the four by threatening Excadrill, Gholdengo, and Sinistcha with spread Heat Wave while gaining Levitate.
decisions.notebook: Core plan: lead Whimsicott+Basculegion into sand structures. Use Tailwind so Scarf Basculegion can outrun Sand Rush Excadrill, then pivot Whimsicott into preserved Politoed to replace sand with rain before Basculegion's Water attack. Mega Delphox is preferred coverage into Excadrill, Gholdengo, and Sinistcha; Heat Wave bypasses Rage Powder through spread targeting, while Mega Levitate removes Ground weakness. Taunt Sinistcha when practical. Keep Politoed healthy enough to win weather resets; avoid exposing it early without a concrete gain.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill (216 in sand) outspeeds all: Iron Head breaks Whimsicott's Focus Sash to 1 HP and sandstorm finishes it end of turn, removing Prankster Encore/Taunt/Tailwind support permanently. Tyranitar Crunch is 2x on Basculegion (67-126%) and can outright KO or leave it in sand/recoil range. Passho Berry means Tyranitar survives a Wave Crash, so the worst case is trading Excadrill for Whimsicott plus heavy chip on their scarfed breaker.

Key math (verified): Excadrill 216 spe in sand outspeeds entire opposing team barring Tailwind. Excadrill Iron Head breaks Whimsicott Sash -> sand chip KOs same turn. Excadrill LO High Horsepower vs Basculegion 54-102%; LO Rock Slide spread ~21-40% Basculegion, 25-47% Whimsicott. Tyranitar Crunch vs Basculegion 67-126%. Basculegion Wave Crash: guaranteed OHKO on Excadrill (104-178%), 66-114% on Tyranitar but Passho halves it -> Tyranitar survives one. Water 0.5x on Sinistcha; Last Respects 2x on Sinistcha and grows per fainted foe mon.

Plan: keep Sandstream up to deny Drizzle; re-lead Tyranitar+Excadrill in later games. Gholdengo (Good as Gold) walls Prankster status and Whimsicott; Sinistcha Rage Powder redirects for Excadrill (Queenly Majesty doesn't stop redirection) and Strength Sap tanks physical Metagross/Tsareena. Beware Icy Wind dropping Excadrill under Tailwind teams, Encore locking Protect, and Delphox-Mega Heat Wave on Excadrill/Sinistcha (Heatproof helps).

decisions.rationale: Excadrill fainted; Gholdengo is the best replacement: Good as Gold blocks Whimsicott's Prankster Taunt/Encore entirely, it resists Moonblast (Steel/Ghost 0.5x), threatens Whimsicott with 2x Make It Rain (breaks Sash, sand chip finishes), and Occa Berry halves an incoming Delphox Heat Wave, keeping it alive. Sinistcha is neutral to Moonblast and gets Taunted/Encored, so it's saved for Metagross/Tsareena duty.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Tailwind immediately lets Scarf Basculegion outrun even maximum-Speed Sand Rush Excadrill. Wave Crash then targets the largest immediate threat and has ample power to KO it; if Excadrill Protects, Tailwind still enables a weather-reset pivot next turn.
decisions.notebook: Core plan versus sand: establish Tailwind so Scarf Basculegion outruns Sand Rush Excadrill, then preserve Whimsicott for utility and pivot to Politoed when a rain-boosted Water attack or weather reset creates concrete value. Prioritize removing Excadrill before exposing Delphox. Mega Delphox is preferred coverage into Excadrill, Gholdengo, and Sinistcha; Heat Wave bypasses Rage Powder via spread targeting, while Mega Levitate removes the Ground weakness. Taunt Sinistcha when practical. Keep Politoed healthy enough for repeated weather control. Tyranitar carries Passho Berry, so do not assume an immediate Water KO without accounting for it.

decisions.rationale: Bring Politoed to remove sand, deny future Sand Rush value, and preserve Delphox from immediate Tyranitar pressure. Rain also sets up stronger Water damage while Tailwind remains available.

Keep Politoed healthy for repeated weather resets. Tyranitar has Passho Berry, so account for reduced first Water hit. Opponent has shown willingness to use single-target Crunch rather than spread Rock Slide.

decisions.rationale: Whimsicott is at 94%, so Focus Sash is no longer active: Make It Rain is a guaranteed KO on it and still chips Politoed 17-31%. Tyranitar is slowest and dies to rain-boosted Weather Ball (91-138%) plus possible Moonblast, so Protect keeps my sand-setter alive to re-deny Drizzle later. This removes Tailwind's controller for free while risking nothing.

Crunch (32-62%) plus Matcha Gotcha (44-78%, no spread reduction with one foe) sums past its 76% remaining even at minimum rolls; only Protect or a Sitrus proc buys it a turn, and Matcha Gotcha also heals Sinistcha against a rain Weather Ball. reflections.summary: Won by executing the pre-set plan cleanly: Tyranitar's Crunch removed the Choice Scarf Basculegion early and later OHKO'd Mega Delphox while Sinistcha's Rage Powder absorbed Shadow Ball, and Gholdengo's Make It Rain finished Focus Sash Whimsicott, collapsing their Tailwind/rain support. The only cost was Excadrill, which was a poor bring into a Drizzle team (Wave Crash / rain Weather Ball) and contributed nothing; Tyranitar also died to repeated rain Weather Ball after its Passho was consumed. reflections.summary: The preview plan overcommitted to Mega Delphox: rain weakened its spread Fire option, while Sinistcha redirected its single-target coverage and Tyranitar removed it with Crunch. That left the chosen four without a durable way through the Sinistcha–Gholdengo endgame.
reflections.adjustment: Do not Mega Evolve Delphox while Tyranitar remains; prioritize Whimsicott using Taunt on Sinistcha, remove Tyranitar first, then commit Delphox once Rage Powder and Crunch cannot freely punish it.
reflections.notebook: Opponent uses Tyranitar Protect to absorb focused rain attacks and Sinistcha Rage Powder to preserve Tyranitar's attacks. Preserve Whimsicott long enough to Taunt Sinistcha when possible. Do not center the preview plan on early Mega Delphox under rain; delay evolution until Tyranitar is controlled. Tyranitar's Passho can be consumed before a rain Weather Ball finish, and Gholdengo's Occa makes Shadow Ball the preferred direct coverage.
